Last release: @thoth-agents/pi-thoth-theme@0.9.0
Target ref: @thoth-agents/pi-thoth-theme@0.10.0

## Core
### Improvements

- `f32629b` feat(pi-thoth-theme): estimated prompt-cache expiry countdown in the status line
- `0139ef2` feat(pi-thoth-theme): color diff stats and exit codes in collapsed tool rows

### Bugfixes

- `d1ac60e` fix(pi-claude-bridge): stream tolerant partial tool arguments

## CLI & Config
### Improvements

- `f714f55` feat(pi-junie-bridge): add Junie ACP provider for JetBrains AI subscriptions

## Core
### Improvements

- `c1f7e47` feat(pi-subagents): persist runtime context and tool-use metrics in history
- `6ae4ee8` feat(pi-subagents): show model names in the model picker
- `e256eb5` feat(pi-core): report background work to Orca native-chat liveness

## CLI & Config
### Improvements

- `f714f55` feat(pi-junie-bridge): add Junie ACP provider for JetBrains AI subscriptions

## Core
### Improvements

- `1240d72` perf(pi-questions-user): memoize preview heights during geometry scans

## Core
### Improvements
